SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'BUSC' AND TABLE_NAME ='TRU_BASELINK'

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CUST_NO,CIF_NO, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK WHERE ISLATEST = 1 GROUP BY CUST_NO,CIF_NO HAVING COUNT(1)>1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUST_NO,CIF_NO ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC, FILE_NAME DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* 
INTO BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_WITH_DUP_20230427  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK
58337
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_WITH_DUP_20230427
58337

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.TRU_BASELINK; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--5 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_WITH_DUP_20230427 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.TRU_BASELINK --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
CUST_NO
,PRIMARY_FLAG
,BR_CD
,STATUS
,AUTH_DT
,AUTH_ID
,MAKER_DT
,MAKER_ID
,CIF_NO
,LAST6_CUST_NO
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_WITH_DUP_20230427; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CUST_NO,CIF_NO, COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK WHERE ISLATEST = 1 GROUP BY CUST_NO,CIF_NO HAVING COUNT(1)>1;
